_comment: Named setup profiles for `mise setup` / `mise setup:<name>` / `mise setup:all`. A profile bundles skill/plugin items (from skills/ + plugins/) and MCP servers (from mcp/*.group.json). `extends` merges a base profile; `"*"` in items or mcp means everything available. `./install setup <profile>` installs the items at user scope, then registers + auths the MCP servers.

default.description: Core set for any machine: first-party skills/plugins + the OAuth/credentialed MCP servers.

ryan.description: Ryan's machine profile — starts from default; add/remove items and mcp servers as needed.

greg.description: Greg's machine profile — the three work skills plus all credentialed MCP servers, no plugins or SOP tooling.

all.description: Everything: every first-party skill/plugin and every MCP server (incl. github/langfuse-prod, which stay unconnected until their header tokens are exported).
